use default
use Raster.COLOUR_MAP
use Raster.IMAGE

use Math = System.Math
use Point = (x: double, y: double)

let random = System.Random(20260918)

let clusters = 6
let sample_size = 30_000

apart(a: Point, b: Point) -> double =>
    (a.x - b.x) * (a.x - b.x) + (a.y - b.y) * (a.y - b.y)

nearest(centres: Collections.List[Point], at: Point) ->
        (index: int, distance: double) is
    let best mut = 0
    let closest mut = apart(centres[0], at)

    for index in 1..centres.count do
        let gap = apart(centres[index], at)

        if gap < closest then
            best = index
            closest = gap
        fi
    od

    return (index = best, distance = closest)
si

let points =
    (1::sample_size)
        |> map(_ =>
            (let angle = random.next_double() * 2.0D * Math.pi
             let radius = Math.sqrt(random.next_double())

             (x = radius * Math.cos(angle),
              y = radius * Math.sin(angle))))
        |> collect_list()

seeded_centres() -> Collections.List[Point] is
    let centres = LIST([points[random.next(points.count)]])

    while centres.count < clusters do
        let weights =
            points
                |> map(at => nearest(centres, at).distance)
                |> collect_list()

        let total = weights |> reduce(0.0D, (a, b) => a + b)

        let target mut = random.next_double() * total
        let chosen mut = 0

        while chosen < weights.count - 1 /\ target > weights[chosen] do
            target = target - weights[chosen]
            chosen = chosen + 1
        od

        centres.add(points[chosen])
    od

    return centres
si

let centres mut = seeded_centres()
let membership = points |> map(_ => 0) |> collect_list()

recentred() -> Collections.List[Point] is
    let totals = LIST[Point]()
    let sizes = LIST[int]()

    for _ in 0..clusters do
        totals.add((x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D))
        sizes.add(0)
    od

    for index in 0..points.count do
        let which = membership[index]
        let at = points[index]

        totals[which] =
            (x = totals[which].x + at.x, y = totals[which].y + at.y)

        sizes[which] = sizes[which] + 1
    od

    return (0..clusters)
        |> map(which =>
            if sizes[which] == 0 then
                centres[which]
            else
                (x = totals[which].x / cast double(sizes[which]),
                 y = totals[which].y / cast double(sizes[which]))
            fi)
        |> collect_list()
si

let passes mut = 0
let settled mut = false

while !settled do
    settled = true
    passes = passes + 1

    for index in 0..points.count do
        let pick = nearest(centres, points[index]).index

        if pick != membership[index] then
            membership[index] = pick
            settled = false
        fi
    od

    centres = recentred()
od

let sizes = (0..clusters) |> map(_ => 0) |> collect_list()

for which in membership do
    sizes[which] = sizes[which] + 1
od

write_line("{sample_size} points, {clusters} clusters, "
           "{passes} passes")
write_line("")
write_line("cluster   size   centroid")

for which in 0..clusters do
    let at = centres[which]

    write_line(
        "{which,7}{sizes[which],7}   "
        "({at.x,7:F4}, {at.y,7:F4})")
od

let image = IMAGE(600, 600)

image.view(-1.06D, -1.06D, 1.06D, 1.06D)

for index in 0..points.count do
    let shade = cast double(membership[index]) / cast double(clusters)

    image.colour(COLOUR_MAP.hue(shade))
    image.dot(points[index].x, points[index].y, 1.4D)
od

image.stroke(2.0D)

for at in centres do
    image.colour(255ub, 255ub, 255ub)
    image.dot(at.x, at.y, 6.0D)

    image.colour(30ub, 30ub, 40ub)
    image.ring(at.x, at.y, 6.0D)
od

image.write("clusters.png")

image.show("clusters.png")
